questions.prompt: Calling a legitimate vendor invoice a phish is:

options.b: a false positive that erodes helpdesk/user trust and buries real reports

questions.prompt: Marketing spam that passes auth and has an unsubscribe link is:

options.b: spam — annoying, not malicious; not an incident

questions.prompt: A CFO "wire request" from an external reply-to with a spoofed display name is:

options.b: BEC phishing — no malware needed, the ask is the attack
